verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a console, REST API, OpenAPI spec and CLI. These are developer building blocks, not a natural-language operating interface. The DigitalOcean MCP servers let AI clients act on DigitalOcean resources, but nothing shows they cover Paperspace machines, notebooks or deployments, so that evidence belongs to the parent platform rather than this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
